title: orbitopt closed-loop GNC record + clock contracts v1.0 (E13-01)
description: One versioned bundle for the five closed-loop GNC record kinds (truth, observation, estimate, command, control_event) plus the simulation clock declaration and the replayable run log. The whole bundle shares one schema_version: the five record kinds reference each other (an estimate names its observations, a control event names its command), so they cannot version independently. Record payloads reuse the E12-01 vocabulary: Observation/Estimate embed a relative-state-1.0 document (validated by orbitopt.mission.multispacecraft.relative_state_from_dict, not re-invented here), epochs are MJD2000 labels on a declared timescale, and the run log may embed a multi-spacecraft-mission-1.0 roster and a canonical-plan digest (E12-08) to bind a run to a sealed plan. The clock timescale is restricted to the uniform scales TT/TDB: a simulation clock must be linear, and a UTC label inside a loop silently jumps by a leap second. Cross-field rules (latency equals t_available minus t_sample, a covariance is symmetric, a record's epoch equals clock t0 plus its elapsed seconds) are checked by orbitopt.gnc, not here. Compatibility policy: adding optional fields is not a breaking change; removing/renaming/narrowing is and gets gnc-contracts-2.0.json.

vec3.description: Three finite numbers (finiteness enforced by orbitopt.gnc.contracts, matching orbitopt.mission.multispacecraft).

relative_state.description: The E12-01 relative state (relative-state-1.0 shape, parsed by orbitopt.mission.multispacecraft.relative_state_from_dict). Sensors measure and the filter estimates the CHASER-minus-TARGET state; the frame enum matches E12-01 exactly -- a relative-state-1.0 document is valid in either direction.

t_s.description: Elapsed seconds from the run's clock t0 (the E12-03 convention: loop timing is elapsed seconds, never wall-clock arithmetic).

truth.description: Truth: the ACTUAL simulated absolute state of one spacecraft at a dynamics epoch. Producers: the simulator only. Consumed by loggers and by offline evaluators -- NEVER by guidance/navigation: orbitopt.gnc.feed rejects any truth record (see the E13-01 isolation tests).

t_sample_s.description: Instant the sensor shutter opened (the clock's declared sample time, never an accumulated drift).

t_available_s.description: Instant the measurement reaches the navigation filter: t_sample_s + latency_s (checked equal by orbitopt.gnc). A dropped frame is simply ABSENT -- remaining timestamps never shift.

covariance_position_m2.description: Measurement position covariance, 3x3 row-major, metres^2. Symmetry/non-negative diagonals checked by orbitopt.gnc.

covariance_velocity_m2_s2.description: Optional measurement velocity covariance, 3x3 row-major, (m/s)^2 (a range-only sensor has none to state). Same rules as covariance_position_m2.

t_update_s.description: Filter-update instant (elapsed s from clock t0).

covariance_rel_m2.description: State covariance, 6x6 row-major (rho then rho_dot, m and m/s). Symmetry/non-negative diagonals checked by orbitopt.gnc.

source_observation_ids.description: Every observation this update used. An estimate with no provenance is a truth leak in disguise; the run-log validator checks these ids exist and were available by t_update_s.

t_tick_s.description: Control tick the law ran at.

t_execute_s.description: Instant the command asks the actuator to fire (>= t_tick_s).

source_estimate_id.description: The estimate the law read. Mandatory: every command must be attributable to a navigation estimate, never to truth (see feed.GuidanceInput).

realized_delta_v_m_s.description: Delta-v the actuator ACTUALLY delivered (0-vector when executed is false). The commanded-minus-realized gap is execution error -- the E12-10 campaign's dominant failure source, recorded per burn here.

phase_s.description: First sample time after t0; must be < period_s. Sampling domains are DECLARED, not derived: sensor ticks, filter updates and control ticks share only t0 (E13-01).

dropped_ticks.description: Tick indices this sensor does not deliver (frame drop). A drop removes one record; every timestamp is computed from the tick index independently, so a drop NEVER shifts later samples.

latency_s.description: Filter compute time after an update before the estimate is readable.
Command-to-fire delay (uplink + valve); the ControlEvent records what really happened at t_exec_s.

mission.description: Optional multi-spacecraft-mission-1.0 roster (E12-01); orbitopt.gnc.recording re-validates it and gates its epoch against the clock t0.

plan_digest.description: Optional E12-08 canonical plan digest this closed-loop run flew against.

config.description: The free-form run configuration (noise parameters, guidance gains, sim settings): what made this log what it is.

run_digest.description: Canonical sha256 over (run_id, mission, plan_digest, config, clock, records), floats quantized like the E12-08 digests (orbitopt.rendezvous.canonical.DIGEST_SIGNIFICANT_DIGITS).
